scope: Exposed, publisher-labelled PopSign development footage with no independent fluent review. The browser drove MediaPipe and the frozen PR #61 worker. Controlled variants replayed the same captured frames through the recognition worker with the model returning null. The subset is targeted and incomplete. No raw landmarks or video are included.

tracker_behavior.note: Tracker observations only. A missing interval may be a rest, occlusion, framing or a tracker failure; a label switch may be a real hand change. Neither identifies stroke boundaries.

trials.note: Aggregate development diagnostics. Missing-hand runs may include normal rests/occlusion and do not establish which part of a sign was lost. Prefix probes are not model inference or a new accuracy result.

abstention_triage.next_review_check: Review fluent annotation, hand shape, face/shoulder references and movement completion; tracking eligibility alone is not a matching sign.
